product_wide_rationale: Governs what session start resolves before it runs the host. It binds the launcher, the session command, and Project identity together, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: Session start resolves the selected work's Project canonical path and starts the host there, failing closed when it does not resolve. The host command stays fixed under CD-0078's reasoning, and the resulting per-Project host environment gap is recorded rather than hidden.
title: Session start resolves the Project directory
